commit_message: Add ADR0154 target-preview and provenance contract tests
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Adds synthetic first-release contract coverage for ADR 0154: Target Preview selection remains transient and never dirties/serializes the Animation Set, the same imported candidate recomputes Native versus Failed when the target skeleton changes, and motion-only Humanoid provenance remains stable across output reordering while ambiguous/sole capable models remain explicit author choices until selected. No third-party model fixtures are introduced.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
